profile_text.body:
Ambarella describes itself as a maker of AI vision processors for edge applications. In its own words, its imaging solutions make cameras smarter by extracting useful data from high-resolution video streams. The site points to uses including advanced driver assistance systems, smart electronic mirrors, drive recorders and autonomous vehicles, and says the company is focused on preparing customers for the road ahead.

The company is a public company headquartered in Santa Clara, California, and trades under the ticker AMBA. Its SEC central index key is 0001280263.

No lawsuits are listed against it. Its law exposure is recorded in California, with a count of 281. No individual products or MCP servers are named in the material available.
